name: nyvora-protocol
description: Continuous Asset Streaming & Split-Routing on Stellar

scripts.build: cargo build --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --release && cd frontend && npm run build
scripts.lint: cargo fmt --all && cargo clippy --all -- -D warnings && cd frontend && npm run lint
scripts.format: cargo fmt --all && cd frontend && npm run format
scripts.setup: npm install && cd frontend && npm install
scripts.clean: cargo clean && cd frontend && rm -rf .next node_modules

author: Nyvora Protocol Team
